A wicked man receives a bribe in secret, to pervert the ways of justice.
A man’s gift makes room for him, and brings him before great men.
Many will entreat the favor of a ruler, and everyone is a friend to a man who gives gifts.

translations.web: A gift in secret pacifies anger, and a bribe in the cloak, strong wrath.
translations.bsb: A gift in secret soothes anger, and a covert bribe pacifies great wrath.
translations.kjv: A gift in secret pacifieth anger: and a reward in the bosom strong wrath.
translations.asv: A gift in secret pacifieth anger; And a present in the bosom, strong wrath.
